designer-initial.summary: Selected a diversity-compliant small EIT image-availability coordinator with an exact 6/12/12/5 design, one image-lifecycle decision owner, closed fault/recovery partitions, and acquisition only as an external upstream event.
questions_for_model: Can the trusted SysML-AADL/GUMBO subset express the Image Availability Governor's two state variables, initialization, pre-state-dependent result correlation, twelve explicit-priority guards, and atomic next-state resolution without duplicating the principal decision?

Can the parameterized A/B/no-acquisition mappings inside CASE-06 and CASE-11 remain two counted top-level contract regions in canonical GUMBO, or is a trace-preserving refinement needed while retaining exactly twelve nontrivial cases?

What one-root containment and delegation mapping preserves six semantic usages, twelve semantic interactions, depth 1..2, and one weak semantic region while separately reporting every required support usage and raw connection?
Can the directive and publication usages retain producer-total nonidentity local contracts without receiving a hidden precomputed command or recomputing the governor's lifecycle policy?

Can the deterministic analyzer exhaust 4320 raw and 1200 qualified snapshots, witness every case and scenario, and check anomalous directive-pair unreachability without acting as another architectural owner?

diversity.selected_primary_scope: Doctor-facing EIT-image generation and analysis availability, with acquisition represented only as an opaque external upstream event
diversity.closest_baseline: replicate-1 small EIT Monitoring-Start and Impedance-Acquisition Coordinator
diversity.why_not_extension_or_rename: The selected system removes monitoring, calibration, acquisition authorization, acquisition command, and impedance delivery; it instead owns requested/ready image identity, consumes external generation results, directs external image generation, and publishes Doctor-facing image availability under correlation, release, completion, and failure priorities. Realizing it requires substituted boundaries, state subject, topology, and policy rather than added detail or renamed replicate-1 session logic.

model-review.summary: Add direct PART-05 and PART-06 relation coverage; allocation and domain behavior remain unchanged.

findings.evidence: ANALYSIS-01/02 exhaust 4320 raw snapshots and 1200 qualified governor snapshots, but root composition reaches only governor-produced downstream values. It cannot by itself execute every PART-05 ImageResolution x QualifiedAcquisition pair or every PART-06 ImageResolution value; for example, GenerationStarted paired with InvalidAcquisition is deliberately unreachable although DIRECTIVE-01 specifies its fail-closed result. The current harness validates reported ownership records and diagnostics but does not infer missing extensional coverage.
findings.requested_change: Revise ANALYSIS-01..03 and PASS-04 so metrics.json and the retained analyzer directly enumerate PART-05's 5*3*11*4=660 pairs with GenerateFromA/GenerateFromB/HoldGeneration fibers 15/15/630, and PART-06's 5*3*11=165 values with delivery fibers 33/33/99, status fibers 15/15/30/45/15/15/30, and exact joint outputs. Keep anomalous-pair unreachability as a separate end-to-end check. Change no PART, INT, campaign metric, case, scenario, root interface, domain behavior, or claim boundary.

findings.evidence: Extensional ownership audit: PART-01 and PART-02 are 6-to-4 status-dependent classifications with fibers 3/1/1/1; PART-03 is an 8-to-5 classification with fibers 4/1/1/1/1; PART-04 performs state-dependent correlation, priority, and twelve-case choice; PART-05 is a 660-to-3 conjunctive fail-closed gate with fibers 630/15/15; and PART-06 jointly classifies state and disposition into delivery and status. No usage is solely a copy, bundle, reroute, bijective enum translation, or A/B rename.

The current SysML-AADL library, trusted Isolette sources, and current accepted checker precedents support System/Process/Thread containment, typed DataPort and PortConnection flows, attribute-based Data records, local GUMBO state, initialization, compute cases, In(state), conditional finite mappings, and sibling fan-out.
findings.requested_change: Realize one explicit root System containing one uncredited behavior-free Process containing the six semantic Threads. Use twelve generated-support boundary delegation declarations plus six direct internal declarations, for eighteen raw PortConnection declarations at physical depth two; give support and delegation no semantic or owner credit.

findings.evidence: CASE-06 and CASE-11 can retain one top-level applicability region each while finite helper expressions select A/B/no-acquisition outcomes. PART-04 can constrain both local post-state variables and one complete ImageResolution, and PART-05/PART-06 can consume only their transmitted owner-local inputs. The 4320 raw and 1200 qualified products plus the direct local products are tractable under the current 180-second analyzer watchdog.

designer-resolution.summary: Approved unchanged architecture with direct downstream ownership coverage added.
